query:
SELECT merge_version
        FROM anime
        WHERE $2 = 'anime' AND id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT merge_version
        FROM episode
        WHERE $2 = 'episode' AND id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
        UNION ALL
        SELECT merge_version
        FROM character
        WHERE $2 = 'character' AND id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
